scope: The unchanged pinned source constructor, original storage init and inherited native parent start execute. Twenty-eight start paths include exact packed 2/3 GiB APFS seeds, full 2 GiB logical hashing and failure admission. Those actual objects then execute 26 I/O and 68 source volume-selector paths without reconstructing driver state. Native OSData/OSString/OSNumber getters execute using measured layouts. Allocation, mapping, class membership, registry collections/provider edges, SHA primitives, descriptor/completion/lock and registration/library calls remain explicit peers. SHA peers hash actual source-selected bytes. Store mode is explicitly zero. The 4 KiB dense fixture is a superblock diagnostic, not a complete APFS volume. Failed starts are retained by the separately checked lifecycle; no rollback/free qualification, actual IOMedia publication, original APFS mount, persistent writes, MMIO or phone operation is claimed.
